analysis: The supplied units are unchanged base-side context from docs/architecture/inference.md, lines 808-1586. They describe MTP idle upgrade, sampling, tool parsing, vision, MiMo and Qwen4 behavior. The only change in this file is one documentation table row at head line 671, in a unit not included in this batch. It documents prompt-chunk attention: 128-query blocks controlled by DARKBLOOM_CBV2_ATTN_QUERY_BLOCK, and a fused .causal call for eligible full-attention chunks with the DARKBLOOM_TTFT_FUSED_CAUSAL_PREFILL=0 rollback. The cited sources are AttentionV1.swift (usesFusedCausalPrefill) and PagedLayerCache.swift (prefillAttend). This is a performance and documentation description. It does not change the encryption, attestation, authorization, cache-scope or salt behavior covered by T-041, TB-002, TB-007 and TB-011. It also makes no new trust claim. One residual question is correctness: a fused causal path must not apply where windowed, softcapped, vision-span or bidirectional masks are required. A mismatch there would be an output-integrity or memory issue (T-007/T-028-adjacent) rather than confidentiality. The implementation source was not supplied, so I cannot verify it. That question belongs to the code review of AttentionV1.swift and PagedLayerCache.swift if they are changed elsewhere in the PR. No security regression is identified in the supplied documentation.
